description: White canvas; grey rounded box upper-centre with serif text 'Q. If every person on Earth aimed a laser pointer at the Moon at the same time, would it change color?' and '-Peter Lipowicz'; black-ink stick figure at left holding a paper; empty blackboard at right.
Moon (small cratered disc) appears upper-centre of blackboard and a dense arc of tiny people appears along bottom of board in one frame; complete on arrival.
Board shows Moon upper-centre and crowd arc at bottom; stick figure with paper at left; Q box above.
Red thin vertical lines rise from the crowd arc; first tile shows short lines not reaching the Moon, so lines grow upward over two frames.
Fan of many red lines from crowd arc converging on the Moon; stick figure and Q box unchanged.
Red hand-drawn zigzag scribble is drawn across the lower part of the red beam fan over six frames; beams and Moon static.
Red zigzag scribble over the beam fan; Moon upper, crowd lower; figure at left.

Hard cut at 9.417s to solid red title card: black drawing of a satellite and dinosaur at top, white 'xkcd's what if? THE VIDEO SERIES'; card is static through about 11.0s; last frame 11.417s is a different scene (greyscale Earth and Moon on gradient). UNRESOLVED exact onset of second cut between 11.0s and 11.417s.
Grey-to-black horizontal gradient background; Earth (grey continents) centre with tiny dots along its left rim; small Moon right.
Two speech-bubble panels appear: left bubble with sun and arms-up stick figure above Earth; right bubble with small Moon and arms-up stick figure above Moon.
Earth and Moon with two white bubbles (sun+figure left, Moon+figure right) on grey-black gradient.
No visible change at tile scale between neighbouring holds; UNRESOLVED what pixels changed (possibly gradient or tiny dots).
Same two bubbles, Earth, Moon on gradient.

Panel labelled 'ALL HUMANS' (crowd of many stick figures) over grey strip 'THE EARTH' with small red 'what if?' badge slides in from left edge over about seven frames; background left gradient goes to black and Earth is covered.
Black background; two bubbles top; 'ALL HUMANS / THE EARTH' panel lower-left covering Earth; Moon dimly right of panel.

Map with completed red dashed circle on Arabian Sea region and '75% WORLD POPULATION' text.
